_id: feat rung: noRelativity. One toggle against golden_baseline.json; everything else is inherited via _extends, so the difference in the result is attributable to this toggle alone. Relativistic clock correction OFF in truth and model.
_delta: Relativistic clock correction OFF in truth and model.
_pairNote: The truth/model pair is written out explicitly, not left to the master enable -- see feat001. ConfigFactory.finalizeConfig reads physics.relativity.clock.truth.enable to decide whether asset.clock.relativisticFracFreq is armed; the master reaches no consumer.
_reportNote: compileTex 'auto' rather than the golden's 'require': a ladder rung's deliverable is its .mat, and a pdflatex hiccup must not throw away a finished 25-minute run. ReportRunner only escalates a failed compile to an error under 'require'.
